verses.sanskrit:
वैशंपायन उवाच।
              ततः कतिपयाहस्य तस्मिन्रैवतके गिरौ। वृष्ण्यन्धकानामभवदुत्सवो नृपसत्तम॥१॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said : O best of kings, a few days after a great festival of the Vrishnis and the Andhakas was held on the Raivataka hill.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र दानं ददुर्वीरा ब्राह्मणेभ्यः सहस्रशः। भोजवृष्ण्यन्धकाश्चैव महे तस्य गिरेस्तदा॥२॥
verses.english: In that mountain-festival of the Bhoja, the Andhakas and the Vrishnis, the hero gave away much wealth to the thousands of Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसादै रत्नचित्रैश्च गिरेस्तस्य समन्ततः। स देशः शोभितो राजन्कल्पवृक्षैश्च सर्वशः॥३॥
verses.english: O king, the region around the hill was adorned with many mansions filled with various gems and they appeared as if they are all Kalpavrikshas (trees giving whatever wanted.)

verses.sanskrit: वादित्राणि च तत्रान्ये वादकाः समवादयन्। ननृतुर्नर्तकाश्चैव जगुर्गेयानि गायनाः॥४॥
verses.english: The musicians played in concert all the musical instruments; the dancers danced and the songsters sang.

verses.sanskrit: अलङ्कृताः कुमाराश्च वृष्णीनां सुमहौजसाम्। यानैर्हाटकचित्रैश्च चञ्चूर्यन्ते स्म सर्वशः॥५॥
verses.english: The effulgent youths of the Vrishni race, adorned with ornaments and riding on golden cars, looked handsome everywhere.

verses.sanskrit: पौराश्च पादचारेण यानैरुच्चावचैस्तथा। सदाराः सानुयात्राश्च शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥६॥
verses.english: Hundred and thousands of the citizens with their wives and attendants went there, some on foot and some on excellent cars. O descendant of Bharata, there roved the lord Haladhara (Baladeva), intoxicated with wine, accompanied by his wife Revati and followed by many Gandharvas (musicians)

verses.sanskrit: ततो हलधरः क्षीबो रेवतीसहितः प्रभुः। अनुगम्यमानो गन्धर्वैरचरत्रत्र भारत॥७॥
तथैव राजा वृष्णीनामुग्रसेनः प्रतापवान्। अनुगीयमानो गन्धर्वैः स्त्रीसहस्रसहायवान्॥८॥
verses.english: There was the powerful king of the Vrishnis, Ugrasena, accompanied by his one thousand wives and followed by the Gandharvas.

verses.sanskrit: रौक्मिणेयश्च साम्बश्च क्षीबौ समरदुर्मदौ। दिव्यमाल्याम्बरधरौ विजह्रातेऽमराविव॥९॥
verses.english: There were the son of Rohini and ever furious in battle Samba. Intoxicated with drink, adorned with beautiful garlands and attired in costly robes, they sported there like two celestials.

verses.sanskrit: अक्रूरः सारणश्चैव गदो बभ्रुर्विदूरथः। निशठश्चारुदेष्णश्च पृथुर्विपृथुरेव च॥१०॥
verses.english: There were Akrura, Sarana, Gada, Babhru, Viduratha, Nishatha, Charudeshna, Pritha, Vipratha. Satyaka, Satyaki, Bhangakara, Maharava, Haridikya, Uddhava and any mothers whose names are not mentioned. They were each separately accompanied by their wives and followed by the musicians. They all adorned that festival on the Raivataka mountain.

verses.sanskrit: सत्यकः सात्यकिश्चैव भङ्गकारमहारवौ। हार्दिक्य उद्धवश्चैव ये चान्ये नानुकीर्तिताः॥११॥
एते परिवृताः स्त्रीभिर्गन्धर्वैश्च पृथक्पृथक्। तमुत्सवं रैवतके शोभयाञ्चक्रिरे तदा॥१२॥
चित्रकौतूहले तस्मिन्वर्तमाने महाद्भुते। वासुदेवश्च पार्थश्च सहितौ परिजग्मतुः॥१३॥
verses.english: When that wonderful festival of great grandeur and delight was continuing, Vasudeva (Krishna) and Partha (Arjuna) went about together.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र चङ्क्रममाणौ तौ वसुदेवसुतां शुभाम्। अलङ्कृतां सखीमध्ये भद्रां ददृशतुस्तदा॥१४॥
verses.english: When thus walking about, they saw the beautiful daughter of Vasudeva, Subhadra, adorned with ornaments in the midst of her companions.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वैव तामर्जुनस्य कन्दर्पः समजायत। तं तदैकाग्रमनसं कृष्णः पार्थमलक्षयत्॥१५॥
verses.english: As soon as Arjuna saw her, he was struck by (the arrow) of the god of love. Seeing that Partha was looking at her with absorbed attention, Krishna.

verses.sanskrit: अब्रवीत्पुरुषव्याघ्रः प्रहसन्निव भारत। वनेचरस्य किमिदं कामेनालोड्यते मनः॥१६॥
verses.english: descendant of Bharata, spoke thus to that best of men (Arjuna) with smiles, “How is it that the mind of one who roams in the forest is thus agitated by desire?

verses.sanskrit: ममैषा भगिनी पार्थ सारणस्य सहोदरी। सुभद्रा नाम भद्रं ते पितुर्मे दयिता सुता। यदि ते वर्तते बुद्धिर्वक्ष्यामि पितरं स्वयम्॥१७॥
verses.english: O Partha, she is my sister and also the sister of Sarana. Her name is Subhadra; she is the most beloved daughter of my father. If your mind is set upon her, I shall then speak to my father."

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच।
              दुहिता वसुदेवस्य वासुदेवस्य च स्वसा। रूपेण चैषा संपन्ना कमिवैषा न मोहयेत्॥१८॥
verses.english: Arjuna said : She is the daughter of Vasudeva and the sister of Vasudeva (Krishna); endued with so much beauty, whom can she not fascinate?

verses.sanskrit: कृतमेव तु कल्याणं सर्वं मम भवेद्ध्रुवम्। यदि स्यान्मम वार्ष्णेयी महिषीयं स्वसा तव॥१९॥
verses.english: If your this sister, this lady of the Vrishni race, become my wife, then certainly do I win prosperity in everything.

verses.sanskrit: प्राप्तौ तु क उपायः स्यात्तं व्रवीहि जनार्दन। आस्थास्यामि तदा सर्वं यदि शक्यं नरेण तत्॥२०॥
verses.english: O Janardana, tell me by what means I may obtain her. I shall do anything achievable by man (in order to obtain her).

verses.sanskrit:
वासुदेव उवाच।
              स्वयंवरः क्षत्रियाणां विवाहः पुरुषर्षभ। स च संशयितः पार्थ स्वभावस्यानिमित्ततः॥२१॥
verses.english: Krishna said: O best of men, Svyaimvara is the marriage form of the Kshatriyas, but, O Partha, that is doubtful, as we do not know her temper and disposition.
verses.bhavadeepa: वक्ष्यामि पितरं स्वयमिति कृष्णेन दापयिष्यामीति सूचितेपि प्राप्तौ तु क उपाय इति पृच्छन्नर्जुनः प्रतिग्रहं नानुमन्यत इति गम्यते ॥२०॥

verses.sanskrit: प्रसह्य हरणं चापि क्षत्रियाणां प्रशस्यते। विवाहहेतुः शूराणामिति धर्मविदो विदुः॥२२॥
verses.english: The men learned in the precepts of religion say that in the case of heroic Kshatriyas, a forcible taking away of a girl for the purpose of marriage is also praiseworthy.
verses.bhavadeepa: स्वभावस्यानिमित्ततः स्त्रीचित्तस्य शौर्यपाण्डित्याद्यनपेक्षत्वात् । स्त्रियो ह्यपरीक्षितेपि पुंसि आपाततो रमणीये सद्यः सकामा भवन्तीति भावः ॥२१॥

verses.sanskrit: स त्वमर्जुन कल्याणीं प्रसह्य भगिनीं मम। हर स्वयंवरे ह्यस्याः को वै वेद चिकीर्षितम्॥२३॥
verses.english: O Arjuna, therefore, carry away this my sister by force, for who know what she may not do in a Svaimvara?

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽर्जुनश्च कृष्णश्च विनिश्चित्येतिकृत्यताम्। शीघ्रगान्पुरुषानन्प्रेषयामासतुस्तदा॥२४॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said : Having thus settled everything about what should be done, Krishna and Arjuna sent some swift messengers to Yudhishthira at Indraprastha, informing him of every thing. That mighty-armed of Pandu (Yudhishthira), as soon as he heard it, gave his assent to it. son

verses.sanskrit: धर्मराजाय तत्सर्वमिन्द्रप्रस्थगताय वै। श्रुत्वैव च महाबाहुरनुजज्ञे स पाण्डवः॥२५॥
